name: ListAggregateRemediations

parameters.help_en:

For more information about how to obtain a rule ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/264148.html

规则ID。多个规则ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔。

AccountId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account

AggregatorId.description_en: The ID of the account group

InvokeType.description_en:
The execution mode of the remediation. Valid values:

NON_EXECUTION: The remediation is not executed.

AUTO_EXECUTION: The remediation is automatically executed.

MANUAL_EXECUTION: The remediation is manually executed.

NOT_CONFIG: The remediation is not configured
InvokeType.description_zh:
修正执行方式。取值：
NON_EXECUTION：不执行。
AUTO_EXECUTION：自动执行。
MANUAL_EXECUTION：手动执行。
NOT_CONFIG：未设置

LastSuccessfulInvocationId.description_en: The ID of the last successful remediation
LastSuccessfulInvocationId.description_zh: 修正最近一次执行成功的ID

LastSuccessfulInvocationTime.description_en: The timestamp of the last successful remediation. Unit: milliseconds
LastSuccessfulInvocationTime.description_zh: 修正最近一次执行成功的时间戳。单位：毫秒

LastSuccessfulInvocationType.description_en:
The mode of the last successful remediation. Valid values:

NON_EXECUTION: The remediation was not executed.

AUTO_EXECUTION: The remediation was automatically executed.

MANUAL_EXECUTION: The remediation was manually executed.

NOT_CONFIG: The remediation was not configured
LastSuccessfulInvocationType.description_zh:
修正最近一次执行成功的方式。取值：

NON_EXECUTION：不执行。
AUTO_EXECUTION：自动执行。
MANUAL_EXECUTION：手动执行。
NOT_CONFIG：未设置

RemediaitonOriginParams.description_en: The converted format of the remediation setting parameters. This parameter is used only to convert the parameters of an OOS template
RemediaitonOriginParams.description_zh: 修正设置参数的转换格式。仅用于转换OOS模板的参数

RemediationId.description_en: The ID of the remediation setting

RemediationSourceType.description_en:
The source of the remediation template. Valid values:

ALIYUN: official template.

CUSTOM: custom template.

NONE: none
RemediationSourceType.description_zh:
执行修正的模板来源。取值：

ALIYUN：官网模板。
CUSTOM：自定义模板。
NONE：无

RemediationTemplateId.description_en: The ID of the remediation template

RemediationType.description_en:
The type of the remediation. Valid values:

OOS: Operation Orchestration Service (official remediation).

FC: Function Compute (custom remediation)
RemediationType.description_zh:
修正类型。取值：

OOS：运维编排（官方修正）。
